purpose: Define reusable prompt inputs for a controlled comparison between generic assistance and an ArcAssist-Web configured condition.

variables.description: A neutral statement of one Web-system evolution concern.
contentRequirements: Describe the desired evolution and its intended outcome.
Keep the wording identical for both conditions.
Do not preselect an architectural solution unless the concern explicitly requires one.
Do not include unverified facts about the current system.

variables.format: Markdown or JSON list of baseline statements
variables.description: Architecture facts needed to constrain the recommendation.

itemShape.source: repository-relative path, document locator, or other stable source locator
itemShape.claim: bounded factual statement supported by the source
itemShape.excerpt: optional supporting excerpt or precise location

contentRequirements: Include only facts that are relevant to the concern.
Separate confirmed facts from unresolved baseline gaps.
Do not summarize a source more broadly than it supports.

variables.format: Markdown or JSON list of evidence items
variables.description: Evidence about Web flows, interface and data boundaries, domain rules, quality attributes, and documentation obligations relevant to the concern.

itemShape.source: repository-relative path, document locator, or other stable source locator
itemShape.kind: web_flow | interface_boundary | data_visibility | domain_rule | quality_attribute | documentation_obligation | other
itemShape.claim: bounded factual statement supported by the source
itemShape.excerpt: optional supporting excerpt or precise location

contentRequirements: Use one item per independently traceable claim.
Include a source locator for every item.
Do not convert a proposed rule, backlog idea, or open question into an existing-system fact.

substitutionRules: Replace each placeholder once with its frozen run value.
Preserve evidence identifiers and source locators exactly in the rendered Condition C prompt.
Reject a run when a required placeholder is empty or unresolved.
Do not add project context to Condition G.
